newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Seoul stocks seen weakening on consolidation.
newsitem.headline: Seoul stocks seen weakening on consolidation.

text.p: The Seoul stock market is expected to remain weak on consolidation throughout Tuesday but brokers ruled out any sharp falls.
"The market became overheated in a short-term period. It needs further consolidation," said Kim Choon-gon at Daewoo Securities. "But active foreign buying interest will limit sharp falls."
Brokers said representative industrials and some companies with good first-half earnings prospects would be spotlighted.
The composite stock index closed on Monday 2.92 points lower at 789.05. -- Yeom Yoon-jeong (822) 727-5647
